signal_contract.hedge_ratio: rolling OLS log(XAU)=alpha+beta*log(XAG), estimated on the 252 completed daily closes preceding the decision day
signal_contract.trade_weights: gross-normalized fixed entry weights: w_xau=side/(1+abs(beta)); w_xag=-side*beta/(1+abs(beta))
signal_contract.entry_execution: signal at synchronized daily close; enter at next synchronized daily open
signal_contract.exit_execution: mean-cross, adverse 4-sigma stop, or 60-trading-day maximum holding detected at daily close; exit next synchronized daily open
signal_contract.cost_semantic: fixed two-leg gross-notional round-trip stress; gross and normal outputs retained so failure attribution does not depend only on severe cost
